info.name: Labor Project Backend - Local
info.description:
Local Postman collection for Labor Project Backend.
Every request shows its contract explicitly in that request: method, URL, required headers, query params, and body.
Protected requests use Header: Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}.
Run Auth > POST /api/auth/login first to get AccessToken and RefreshToken.

variable.description: Local backend base URL for testing.
Local backend WebSocket base URL for Worker Mobile realtime connection.
Bearer access token returned by POST /api/auth/login. Used in Authorization header.
Refresh token returned by POST /api/auth/login. Used by POST /api/auth/refresh body.
Token returned when login gets ACTIVE_SESSION_EXISTS. Used by confirm-force login.

Client device name sent in login body.
Worker Firebase Cloud Messaging token for push notification tests.
Worker push token platform: android, ios, web, or unknown.

WorkerCode used by Admin Workers /:workerCode routes, for example MN000012.

TicketNumber (vehicle-level identity) returned as the top-level TicketNumber field by POST /api/gate/tickets. Used by all /api/admin/vehicle-jobs/{ticketNumber}/... routes. Do not confuse with ticketNo, which is the Business Ticket identity (Ticket.TicketNo).
ticketNo returned by POST /api/gate/tickets. With the Gate payload this equals TicketNo.

request.description:
Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/auth/login
Auth: No auth required
Headers: Content-Type: application/json
Query: None
Body: Admin username/password only.
Response: login returns tokens only: AccessToken, RefreshToken, TokenType, ExpiresIn.
Notes: Saves AccessToken and RefreshToken into collection variables when login succeeds. Call GET /api/auth/me after login to fetch admin profile data, permissions, and latest activity.

Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/auth/login
Auth: No auth required
Headers: Content-Type: application/json
Query: None
Body: Worker username plus password=phone from worker creation, DeviceId, DeviceName, optional FcmToken, and optional Platform.
Response: login returns tokens only: AccessToken, RefreshToken, TokenType, ExpiresIn. FcmToken is not returned.
Notes: Saves AccessToken and RefreshToken into collection variables when login succeeds. If another worker session exists on a different device, saves LoginChallengeToken for POST /api/auth/login/confirm-force. When FcmToken is sent by a worker, backend stores it by WorkerCode + DeviceId + Platform for push notifications. If Mobile does not have an FCM token yet, omit FcmToken here and call POST /api/auth/push-token after Firebase SDK returns the token. Call GET /api/auth/me after login to fetch worker profile data. After successful worker login, open WS /ws/workers, then call POST /api/workers/me/online.

Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/auth/login
Auth: No auth required
Headers: Content-Type: application/json
Query: None
Body: Worker username plus password=phone, DeviceId, and DeviceName. FcmToken is intentionally omitted in this example.
Response: login returns tokens only: AccessToken, RefreshToken, TokenType, ExpiresIn.
Notes: Use this when Mobile has not received an FCM token from Firebase SDK yet. After login succeeds and Firebase SDK returns the token, call POST /api/auth/push-token with FcmToken and Platform.

Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/auth/login/confirm-force
Auth: No auth required
Headers: Content-Type: application/json
Query: None
Body: JSON: LoginChallengeToken, DeviceId, DeviceName, optional FcmToken, optional Platform
Notes: Use only after login returns ACTIVE_SESSION_EXISTS with a LoginChallengeToken. If FcmToken is sent, backend revokes the old session push token and stores the new token for this WorkerCode. If Mobile does not have an FCM token yet, omit it here and call POST /api/auth/push-token after Firebase SDK returns the token.

header.description: Required for protected routes. Format: Bearer <AccessToken>.

request.description:
Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/auth/push-token
Auth: Worker access token
Body: FcmToken required, Platform optional. DeviceId is optional and defaults to the current session DeviceId.
Response: StatusCode, Code, Message, WorkerCode, DeviceId, Platform. FcmToken is not returned.
Notes: Use after login when FcmToken was not available during Auth login, or whenever Firebase SDK returns a refreshed token. This endpoint does not request a token from Firebase; Mobile must obtain the FCM token from Firebase SDK first. Backend stores token by WorkerCode + DeviceId + Platform and uses it for worker push notifications.

request.description:
Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/users
Auth: Required via Authorization header
Headers: Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}. Do not set Content-Type manually for multipart/form-data; Postman sets the boundary.
Query: None
Body: multipart/form-data from create-worker UI. Optional file field: image. Text fields: FullName, Phone, Nationality, ShirtType, ShirtNumber, ShiftNo, optional WorkStartDate, Status.
Response: message only, Worker created successfully.
Notes: Admin only. username defaults to WorkerCode generated from nationality + ShirtType + ShirtNumber, such as MN000012. nationality accepts Myanmar or Cambodia. ShirtType accepts Navy, Blue, or Green. ShirtNumber is unique and cannot be reused. Worker password is always the hashed value of phone, and phone is saved to accounts.phone. ShiftNo 1 uses preset 08:00-18:00 and ShiftNo 2 uses preset 18:00-08:00. WorkStartDate is optional; if omitted, backend uses the current Bangkok date. Uploaded image is stored under /uploads/workers and saved as accounts.ImageUrl. JSON body with ImageUrl/img is still supported when no file upload is needed.

Method: PATCH
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/users/{{workerCode}}
Auth: Required via Authorization header
Headers: Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}, Content-Type: application/json
Query: None
Body: JSON fields from worker edit UI: ImageUrl/img, WorkerCode, FullName, Phone, Nationality, Status, Position, ShirtNumber, ShirtType, optional WorkStartDate, ShiftStartTime, ShiftEndTime. nationality accepts Myanmar or Cambodia. ShirtType accepts Navy, Blue, or Green. ShirtNumber is unique and cannot be reused. ShiftNo cannot be updated in this body. Admin edits only ShiftStartTime and ShiftEndTime; backend derives ShiftNo and ShiftName from ShiftStartTime. ShiftStartTime and ShiftEndTime must be time only in HH:mm and must be sent together.
Notes: Admin only. {{workerCode}} must be WorkerCode. If nationality, ShirtType, or ShirtNumber is sent without WorkerCode, backend regenerates WorkerCode/username from nationality + ShirtType + ShirtNumber, using existing profile values for fields omitted from the request. status inactive revokes active worker sessions. Password reset remains separate at PATCH /api/admin/users/{{workerCode}}/password.

Method: PATCH
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/users/{{workerCode}}/password
Auth: Required via Authorization header
Headers: Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}, Content-Type: application/json
Query: None
Body: JSON: NewPassword
Notes: Admin only. {{workerCode}} must be WorkerCode. Resets worker password and revokes worker sessions.

Method: GET
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/jobs/workers/status
Auth: Admin access token
Body: None
Notes: Admin Jobs. Lists active current-shift workers for the worker queue board. Workers with an active queue/assignment remain visible even when their Worker WebSocket is disconnected; use SocketConnected to show the connection state. Response includes FullName, WorkerCode, ShirtNumber, ImageUrl, ShiftName, LatestActivityAt, StatusEnteredAt, QueuePosition, SocketConnected, and one status only. Data is already sorted by board column order and the real order inside each status. Ready workers use Redis QueuePosition. Board status values: open_app, ready, assigned, waiting_team, working, break.

Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/jobs/workers/{{workerCode}}/status/force
Auth: Admin access token
Body: status open_app|ready|break, optional reason
Response: Message, FullName, WorkerCode, Status only.
Notes: Admin Jobs. {{workerCode}} must be WorkerCode and must have an active Worker WebSocket connection for this force action. If the Worker socket is not connected, response is 409 WORKER_NOT_ONLINE. open_app means the Worker opened the app but is not in the ready queue; it removes the Worker from dispatch queue. ready puts the Worker into Redis queue. break starts a configured break, default 15 minutes, and consumes a break count. GET /api/admin/jobs/workers/status can still show active queue or assignment workers with SocketConnected=false when their socket is disconnected.

request.description:
Method: GET
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/vehicle-jobs/operations
Auth: Admin access token with jobs:read permission
Purpose: Vehicle operation board for delivery-truck queue/check-in page. Returns ServerTime, summary counts, OperationStatus, workers with ShiftName, scan progress, markets with DropoffPoint, stalls/tickets with RejectReason, and products.
OperationStatus values: unload_now, waiting_unload, waiting_queue, driver_waiting_queue. Work progress should be read from VehicleJob.Status, Workers[].AssignmentStatus, Markets[].Tickets[].Status, and ConfirmationStatus.

request.description:
Method: GET
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/vehicle-jobs/history?date_from=2026-07-01&date_to=2026-07-07&page=1&limit=20&search=&status=
Auth: Admin access token
Query: date_from/date_to/search/status optional. date is still supported as a legacy single-day filter. status can match vehicle, market, booth/ticket, confirmation, or worker assignment status. page optional; when page is omitted backend returns all matching rows ordered by latest CreatedAt. When page is sent backend returns that page and pagination metadata.
Supported status examples: WAIT, WORKING, DELIVERED, REJECT, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, PENDING, ACCEPTED, SCANNED, TIMEOUT.
Response: Data[].VehicleJob plus Markets[].Tickets[].Products[] for the Admin history report. Search can match TicketNo, license plate, MarketCode/MarketName, BoothCode/BoothName, ProductCode/ProductName, or vendor name.
Notes: Use search with a license plate to see what that vehicle delivered, use MarketCode/MarketName to see vehicles that delivered to that market, or use BoothCode/BoothName to see vehicles and products for that booth in the selected date range.
Updated fields: Data[].VehicleJob now also returns WorkStart, SubmittedCompleteAt, VendorConfirmedCompleteAt, CompletedAt, and DurationSeconds (all derived, never stored). Each item also returns Workers[] (every worker ever dispatched to the vehicle job, with AcceptedAt/ScannedAt/StartedAt/SubmittedAt/ReleasedAt/FinalStatus/Cancellation), Timeline[] (chronological merge of worker lifecycle, booth submission/reject/confirm, and admin-action events), and Finance (job-level totals reused from the same persisted financial records as /financials, never recalculated). Markets[].Booths[] (renamed from the older Tickets[] naming) also gained VendorLineId, RejectReason, SubmittedWorkerCodes, SubmittedAt, ConfirmedAt, and RejectionHistory.

query.description: Optional date range start in YYYY-MM-DD.
Optional date range end in YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive.
Alias of worker_code. Filters to one worker's rows.
Optional filter by the worker's shift number.

request.description:
Method: GET
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/vehicle-jobs/history/daily-worker-income
Auth: Admin access token with jobs:read permission
Query: date_from/date_to (aliases: from/to), worker_code (alias: workerCode), status, shift, search (alias: keyword), page, limit (alias: pageSize). Nested under the existing /vehicle-jobs/history namespace rather than a new /work-history root, since this report is derived from the same Vehicle Job History data.
Notes: One row per worker per Business Ticket. Payable is TicketWorker.FinalEarningAmount taken as-is once financialized; never recomputed.
Response: Data[] of {Id, BusinessDate, Shift, TicketNumber, MarketJobNo, Plate, Worker: {Code, Name, Shirt}, AssignedStalls, ConfirmedStalls, Collected, Payable, Status, AcceptedAt, ScannedAt, StartedAt, SubmittedAt, ConfirmedAt, ReleasedAt, Cancellation}, plus Pagination.

Method: GET
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/vehicle-jobs/{{ticketNo}}/financials
Auth: Admin access token
Permission: jobs:read
Body: None
Response: Persisted financial breakdown grouped VehicleJob -> Booth -> Product -> Worker. FinancialStatus is PENDING, PARTIAL, or FINALIZED.
Important: This endpoint is read-only. It does not recompute money from current MasterRate. Product financial values come from persisted TicketProductFinancial records and worker earnings come from persisted TicketWorkerPayment.FinalAmount.

Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/vehicle-jobs/{{ticketNo}}/assign-workers
Auth: Admin access token
Body: WorkerCodes array
Notes: Admin manually assigns the vehicle job to selected workers. Workers must be active, must not already have an active assignment, and must currently be ready in the Redis queue. Backend marks them assigned for UI, removes them from ready queue, and starts the 1-minute accept timeout.

Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/vehicle-jobs/{{ticketNo}}/scan-deadline/extend
Auth: Admin access token
Body: minutes required. Omit WorkerCodes to extend all ACCEPTED workers whose scan deadline has not expired; send WorkerCodes to extend selected workers only.
Example selected worker body: { "minutes": 10, "WorkerCodes": ["MN000115"] }
Response: ticketNo, assignments[].WorkerCode/status/ScanDeadlineAt/ScanDeadlineUnixMs.
Notes: Extends ScanDeadlineAt and ScanDeadlineUnixMs, then reschedules the background scan timeout for the updated ACCEPTED assignments. Expired assignments are not extended.

Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/vehicle-jobs/{{ticketNo}}/workers/{{workerCode}}/assignment/cancel
Auth: Admin access token
Body: optional reason
Notes: Cancels one active worker assignment by ticketNo + WorkerCode, removes that worker from dispatch queue, and shows the worker as open_app. Backend does not auto-fill a replacement worker.

Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/vehicle-jobs/{{ticketNumber}}/stalls/{{boothCode}}/override-count
Auth: Admin access token with jobs:override_count permission
Body: ReasonCode (required), ReasonText (optional), Counts[] of {ProductCode, PackageCode, ActualQuantity}
Notes: Admin submits or corrects a booth's product quantities on behalf of a worker. Looks up products by ProductCode+PackageCode, the same business key the worker submit-count flow uses. Returns 409 if the booth is already closed or already financialized. Every call is recorded in AdminActionLog and appears in GET /api/admin/vehicle-jobs/history Timeline as an ADMIN_ACTION event.
Response: Message, TicketNumber, BoothCode, Status, ReasonCode, ReasonText, Products[] of {ProductCode, PackageCode, PreviousQuantity, ConfirmedQuantity}.

Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/vehicle-jobs/{{ticketNumber}}/wait
Auth: Admin access token with jobs:wait permission
Body: ReasonCode (required), ReasonText (optional)
Notes: Sets the vehicle job back to WAIT. Only allowed while every booth is still WAIT (no booth has started work), so no in-progress assignment/queue/timeout state needs to be unwound. Does not touch VehicleJobAssignment. Returns 409 if the vehicle job is already closed or already has a booth in progress. Recorded in AdminActionLog and appears in GET /api/admin/vehicle-jobs/history Timeline as an ADMIN_ACTION event.
Response: Message, TicketNumber, Status, ReasonCode, ReasonText.

Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/vehicle-jobs/{{ticketNumber}}/release-workers
Auth: Admin access token with jobs:release_workers permission
Body: ReasonCode (required), ReasonText (optional)
Notes: Releases the dispatched worker team back to the FIFO queue once every booth has been submitted — status DELIVERED (submitted, awaiting vendor confirmation), COMPLETED (vendor confirmed), or CANCELLED. Does NOT require vendor confirmation first: the worker's physical duty ends the moment they submit counted quantities, so the team can be released while a booth is still DELIVERED and waiting on the vendor. Also does not wait for the whole vehicle job to close, Gate to signal no more Business Tickets, or per-Business-Ticket financial finalize — money is settled later independently, and releasing workers does not change the booth/vehicle job's own status (it stays DELIVERED/WORKING in Work History until the vendor actually confirms or times out). Returns 409 if the vehicle job is already closed (VEHICLE_JOB_CLOSED), has no booths yet (NO_SUBMITTED_BOOTHS), has a booth still WAIT/WORKING/REJECT — REJECT means an unresolved vendor rejection the worker must fix and resubmit first (BOOTHS_NOT_SUBMITTED), or has no releasable workers (NO_RELEASABLE_WORKERS). Recorded in AdminActionLog and appears in GET /api/admin/vehicle-jobs/history Timeline as an ADMIN_ACTION event plus a WORKER_RELEASED event per worker.
Response: Message, TicketNumber, ReleasedWorkerCodes[], ReasonCode, ReasonText.
Admin Audit worker performance for today using Asia/Bangkok business date.
Admin Audit worker performance for one worker today.
Admin Audit worker performance for a Bangkok date range.
Admin Audit worker performance for one worker in a Bangkok date range.

Method: GET
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/settings
Auth: Admin access token with settings:read permission
Body: None
Notes: Returns runtime settings used by backend calculations.

Method: PATCH
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/settings
Auth: Admin access token with settings:update permission
Body: Partial JSON is allowed. Updated settings affect new calculations after this request; existing assignment deadlines already saved in DB remain unchanged. WorkerAcceptTimeoutLimit controls how many consecutive accept timeouts are allowed before the worker is moved to open_app and the current shift is closed. WorkerScanWarningBeforeMinutes controls when Admin SSE receives ASSIGNMENT_SCAN_DEADLINE_WARNING for ACCEPTED workers who have not checked in. WorkerScanTeamRemainingMinutes controls the shortened scan window for remaining team members after the first worker checks in. VendorConfirmTimeoutHours auto-confirms first submitted totals after vendor timeout, and VendorReconfirmTimeoutHours does the same after a rejected ticket is resubmitted.

Method: GET
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/roles
Auth: Admin access token with roles:read permission
Body: None
Notes: Lists admin permission levels ordered from highest to lowest and includes admin accounts grouped inside each role. Permissions are stored per admin account in DB, not derived from this response.

Method: GET
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/gate-clients
Auth: Admin access token with gate_clients:read permission
Body: None
Notes: Lists Gate clients for system-to-system authentication. Response never includes ClientSecret or SecretHash.

Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/gate-clients
Auth: Admin access token with gate_clients:create permission
Body: name required, optional ClientId and status active|inactive
Notes: Creates a Gate client credential. ClientSecret is shown only once in this response and is saved to {{gateClientSecret}} for Postman testing. Backend stores only SecretHash in DB.

Method: PATCH
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/gate-clients/{{gateClientId}}
Auth: Admin access token with gate_clients:update permission
Body: name and/or status active|inactive
Notes: Activate/disable a Gate client without exposing or changing its secret.

Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/gate-clients/{{gateClientId}}/secret/rotate
Auth: Admin access token with gate_clients:rotate_secret permission
Body: None
Notes: Generates a new ClientSecret for the same ClientId and replaces the stored SecretHash. The old secret stops working immediately. The new secret is shown only once and saved to {{gateClientSecret}}.

Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/admins
Auth: Admin access token with admins:create permission
Body: username, password, FullName, optional position/email/phone/status, PermissionLevel owner|manager|supervisor, and permissions array
Notes: Creates role=admin only and saves email/phone to accounts.email/accounts.phone when provided. Seed owner admin can create manager/supervisor. Manager can create supervisor only. No API can create owner because the actor must have a higher PermissionLevel than the new account. Saves created account id to {{adminUserId}}.

Method: GET
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/users/{{adminUserId}}/permissions
Auth: Admin access token with permissions:read permission
Body: None
Notes: Use an admin account id, not a worker id. The target admin must have a lower PermissionLevel than the actor. Use GET /api/auth/me to see your own permissions.

Method: PATCH
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/admin/users/{{adminUserId}}/permissions
Auth: Admin access token with permissions:update permission
Body: PermissionLevel, optional status active|inactive, and permissions array
Notes: Updates admin PermissionLevel, status, and permissions, then revokes active sessions of that admin account. Permission is stored per account from DB. The actor must have a higher PermissionLevel rank than both the target admin and the new PermissionLevel. The target admin must login again to receive the latest permissions/status in the token.

request.description:
Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/gate/tickets
Auth: Gate Basic Auth using {{gateClientId}} / {{gateClientSecret}}. Create credentials with Admin Settings > POST /api/admin/gate-clients first.
Headers: Content-Type: application/json
Body: One request per Business Ticket (TicketNo), always against exactly one MarketCode. A vehicle (TicketNumber) may generate multiple Business Tickets over time as it unloads at different markets — send the same TicketNumber again with a new TicketNo; no duplicate vehicle job is created. Required root fields: TicketNumber, TicketNo, TicketCreatedAt, TicketCount, BoothCount, MarketCode, LicensePlate, LicensePlateProvince, VehicleTypeCode, VehicleTypeName, Booths, Dispatch. TicketCount is the total number of Business Tickets Gate will send for this TicketNumber (the number of distinct markets in the order) — Gate always knows this upfront; send the same value on every request for the same TicketNumber. Each Booth requires BoothCode and Products. Each Product requires ProductCode, PackageCode, Quantity. BoothCount must equal Booths.length. BoothCode cannot be duplicated in the same request. ProductCode + PackageCode cannot be duplicated inside the same booth.
Financial boundary: Gate Quantity is operational/dispatch quantity only. The backend may snapshot the applicable Master rate internally at Gate Create, but Gate Create does not calculate or expose StallPayment, WorkerPayment, OrderRemainder, Fund, or final financial amounts. Financialization happens only after worker-confirmed quantities are vendor-confirmed or auto-confirmed.
Response: Result, TicketNumber, Ticket, Market, Booths with operational product data, WorkerCount for dispatch, and Qr (DriverQrToken only, shared across the whole vehicle). Workers check in by scanning the barcode already printed on the physical Gate paper ticket (Ticket.TicketNo) — no separate QR field is generated. Ticket.Status is derived from Dispatch only: true = unload_now, false = waiting_unload.
Idempotency: Gate transaction ref is derived from TicketNumber + TicketNo (not MarketCode, since one Business Ticket is already always one market). Same payload returns REPLAYED. Same idempotency key with a different payload returns 409.
Vehicle closing: once the number of Business Tickets created for a TicketNumber reaches TicketCount, and every booth across all of them is terminal, the vehicle job completes and its workers return to queue automatically. There is no separate close endpoint.
Notes: Saves gateResult, ticketNumber, ticketNo, marketCode, first BoothCode, first ProductCode, first PackageCode, workerCount, and driverQrToken into collection variables.

Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/driver/qr-sessions
Auth: No auth required
Body: JSON QrToken from driver QR
Notes: Creates a 24-hour driver guest session and saves driverSessionToken.

Method: GET
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/driver/jobs/current
Auth: Driver guest session via Authorization: Bearer {{driverSessionToken}}
Body: None

Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/driver/jobs/{{ticketNo}}/ready
Auth: Driver guest session
Body: None
Response: ticketNo, LicensePlate, LicensePlateProvince, status.
Notes: Marks vehicle job WORKING and dispatches ready workers from Redis FIFO queue. Workers check in separately by scanning each Business Ticket's own barcode via POST /api/workers/me/assignments/{ticketNumber}/check-in-barcode.

item.name: Worker Application
item.description: WebSocket setup: Postman HTTP request items cannot open ws:// as a native WebSocket tab. Create it manually with New > WebSocket, then use {{wsBaseUrl}}/ws/workers?token={{accessToken}} and click Connect. Do this after POST /api/auth/login - Worker and before POST /api/workers/me/online. WORKER_CONNECTED payload returns WorkerCode, not internal account_id. The socket only confirms the worker realtime connection is alive; the worker becomes online/ready after POST /api/workers/me/online.

request.description:
Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/workers/me/online
Auth: Worker access token
Body: None
Response: StatusCode, Code, Message. Success response is { "StatusCode": 200, "Code": "WORKER_ONLINE_SUCCESS", "Message": "Worker entered queue successfully." }.
Notes: Requires active /ws/workers WebSocket. From open_app, worker can enter queue only once per shift/day. If current status is break, worker can call this endpoint to return early before break timer ends. Returns 403 if the worker has no current schedule or is outside the assigned shift. OUTSIDE_WORK_SHIFT includes shift and remaining_time text for the mobile modal. Daily counts are returned by GET /api/workers/me/status.

Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/workers/me/offline
Auth: Worker access token
Body: None
Response: StatusCode, Code, Message. Success response is { "StatusCode": 200, "Code": "WORKER_OFFLINE_SUCCESS", "Message": "Worker left queue successfully." }. The worker is removed from Redis queue internally and the current shift is closed so the worker cannot re-enter queue in the same shift. Daily counts are returned by GET /api/workers/me/status.

Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/workers/me/break
Auth: Worker access token
Body: None
Response: FullName, WorkerCode, status, BreakCountUsed, BreakCountLimit. status is break.
Notes: Puts worker into break status for the configured duration, default 15 minutes. Requires worker to be ready and inside the current shift time. OUTSIDE_WORK_SHIFT includes shift and remaining_time text for the mobile modal. Default max is 4 breaks per shift from WorkerBreakLimit. BullMQ returns worker to the tail of Redis queue automatically when break ends; worker can call /online early while status is break.

item.name: GET /api/workers/me/status

request.description:
Method: GET
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/workers/me/status
Auth: Worker access token
Body: None
Safe to call any time, including right after the app is closed and reopened, since CurrentJob is always re-derived live from persisted assignment state (not from a one-time push payload).
Response: FullName, WorkerCode, ImageUrl, Status, TodayJobCount, BreakCountUsed, CompletedJobCount, Nationality, WorkStartDate, Phone, and Shift name/start/end. Status is one of open_app, ready, assigned, waiting_team, working, break. When Status is break, response includes BreakUntil, BreakUntilUnixMs, and RemainingBreakTime. Status is assigned both while the assignment is still PENDING (worker has not pressed accept yet) and once it is ACCEPTED (waiting to scan) — the two sub-cases are told apart by which deadline pair is non-null: while PENDING, CurrentJob.AcceptDeadlineAt/AcceptDeadlineUnixMs are set and ScanDeadlineAt/ScanDeadlineUnixMs are null; once ACCEPTED, ScanDeadlineAt/ScanDeadlineUnixMs are set and AcceptDeadlineAt/AcceptDeadlineUnixMs are null. When Status is waiting_team or working (worker has already scanned), all four deadline fields are null. When Status is assigned, waiting_team, or working, response includes CurrentJob with TicketNumber, LicensePlate, LicensePlateProvince, VehicleType, TeamScan, Markets[] (each with TicketNo — scan its barcode via check-in-barcode, Booths[].Products[] using Gate Quantity), and Team[].ShirtNumber/FullName/ScanStatus/ScannedAt.

item.description:
Method: GET
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/workers/me/status
Auth: Worker access token
Body: None
Response: FullName, WorkerCode, ImageUrl, Status, TodayJobCount, BreakCountUsed, CompletedJobCount, Nationality, WorkStartDate, Phone, and Shift name/start/end. Status is one of open_app, ready, assigned, waiting_team, working, break. When Status is break, response includes BreakUntil, BreakUntilUnixMs, and RemainingBreakTime. When Status is assigned, response includes CurrentJob.ScanDeadlineAt and CurrentJob.ScanDeadlineUnixMs. When Status is waiting_team or working, CurrentJob.ScanDeadlineAt and CurrentJob.ScanDeadlineUnixMs are null. When Status is assigned, waiting_team, or working, response includes CurrentJob with TicketNo, LicensePlate, LicensePlateProvince, VehicleType, TeamScan, Markets[].Booths[].Products[] using Gate Quantity, and Team[].ShirtNumber/FullName/ScanStatus/ScannedAt.

item.name: GET /api/workers/me/assignments/history

query.description: Assignment created date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

request.description:
Method: GET
URL single date: {{baseUrl}}/api/workers/me/assignments/history?date=2026-07-07
URL date range: {{baseUrl}}/api/workers/me/assignments/history?date_from=2026-08-01&date_to=2026-08-14
Auth: Worker access token
Query: send either date, or date_from + date_to together. All fields use YYYY-MM-DD. date cannot be combined with date_from/date_to. Range is inclusive and limited to 31 calendar days. Body: None
Response: Date, Summary.JobCount, Summary.AcceptTimeoutJobCount, Summary.CompletedJobCount, and Data[]. Each assignment includes TicketNo, LicensePlate, Status, Markets[].Booths[].CompletedAt, Markets[].Booths[].Products[].ConfirmedQuantity, and Rating as a single integer 1-5 or null. CompletedAt is the per-booth GateTicket completion timestamp and is null when that booth/case is not complete. No earnings, TotalEarnings, booth amount, product FinalAmount, or worker payment breakdown are returned. Dates are interpreted in Asia/Bangkok time and filter by assignment CreatedAt using [startAt, dayAfterEndAt).

request.description:
Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/workers/me/assignments/{{ticketNumber}}/accept
Auth: Worker access token
Body: None
Path: {{ticketNumber}} comes from WORKER_ASSIGNED.ticketNumber.
Notes: Assignment must be PENDING and accepted within WorkerAcceptDeadlineSeconds, default 60 seconds. If not accepted in time, assignment becomes TIMEOUT and the worker returns to the tail of the queue even when the Worker WebSocket is disconnected. The consecutive accept-timeout streak resets after a successful accept. After WorkerAcceptTimeoutLimit consecutive accept timeouts, default 3, the worker is moved to open_app and cannot re-enter the queue in the same shift. Response is trimmed for the worker job detail screen only: LicensePlate, LicensePlateProvince, ScanDeadlineAt, ScanDeadlineUnixMs, team[].FullName/WorkerCode/ImageUrl/ScanStatus, markets[].TicketNo/marketName/StallCount/stalls[].boothCode/boothName/ProductCount/products[].productCode/productName/quantity/packageName. ScanDeadlineAt is the persisted assignment QR scan deadline in ISO 8601 UTC; ScanDeadlineUnixMs is the same value in Unix milliseconds for mobile countdown. markets[].TicketNo is the Business Ticket id printed as a barcode on the physical Gate paper ticket — send it as TicketNo to POST .../check-in-barcode next. Use the same {{ticketNumber}} plus TicketNo and stalls[].BoothCode later with POST /api/workers/me/assignments/{{ticketNumber}}/tickets/complete.

Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/workers/me/assignments/{{ticketNumber}}/check-in-barcode
Auth: Worker access token
Path: {{ticketNumber}} is the vehicle-level TicketNumber of the worker's current assignment (same value used by accept).
Body: TicketNo (required) — one Business Ticket's ticket_no, the value printed as a barcode on the physical Gate paper ticket. Also readable from Markets[].TicketNo in the accept response or CurrentJob.Markets[].TicketNo from GET /api/workers/me/status. It is a real business identifier (not a generated secret), resolved safely by scoping the lookup to this worker's own vehicle. Scanning any one Business Ticket under the vehicle checks in the whole team.
Response: Status, WorkerStatus, WorkerCode, TicketNumber, TeamScan. Normally { "Status": "SCANNED", "WorkerStatus": "waiting_team", "WorkerCode": "MN000142", "TicketNumber": "TRUCK-20260804-001", "TeamScan": { "WorkersRequired": 3, "CheckedInCount": 1, "RemainingCount": 2, "IsReady": false } }.
Notes: Checks worker into the job only while ScanDeadlineAt is still valid. Default scan window comes from WorkerScanDeadlineMinutes after accept. After this worker scans, WorkerStatus is waiting_team until every active/eligible assignment in the team has scanned, then working. Admin SSE receives ASSIGNMENT_SCAN_DEADLINE_WARNING when an ACCEPTED worker has not checked in and remaining scan time is below WorkerScanWarningBeforeMinutes. In a multi-worker team, once the first worker checks in, remaining ACCEPTED workers receive ASSIGNMENT_SCAN_DEADLINE_SHORTENED and their ScanDeadlineAt/ScanDeadlineUnixMs is shortened by WorkerScanTeamRemainingMinutes from that first check-in. If scan time expires by API call or background timeout, the assignment becomes TIMEOUT and worker status returns to open_app. Admin can extend ScanDeadlineAt/ScanDeadlineUnixMs and the worker can retry with the same TicketNo if the assignment is still ACCEPTED. If active/eligible team scan is ready, vehicle job moves to WORKING.

Method: GET
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/workers/me/products/{{productCode}}/packages
Auth: Worker access token
Use when a worker counts produce at a booth and finds it is actually a different package size than what Gate originally declared for that product line (not just a different quantity). productCode must be one already present on the ticket being edited (from the accept/check-in/status response's product lines) — this only looks up alternate packages of that same product, it does not switch to a different product.
Response: productCode, productName, and packages[] with packageCode (send back as the new PackageCode on submit), packageName (UI display only), packageWeight.
Notes: 404 if no active product matches productCode.

exec: // Production-like response does not expose LINE postback tokens.
// Vendor confirm/reject should come from the real LINE OA button postback.

request.description:
Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/workers/me/assignments/{{ticketNumber}}/tickets/complete
Auth: Worker access token
Body: TicketNo, BoothCode and Items required. TicketNo names which Business Ticket this submission belongs to — required because two Business Tickets under the same vehicle, against different markets, can legitimately share the same BoothCode; TicketNo plus BoothCode together resolve the exact booth unambiguously. Send BoothCode in body so codes containing / such as OM3/40 do not need URL encoding. Send every ProductCode + PackageCode in the ticket with ConfirmedQuantity counted by the worker.
Package switch: to change a product's package (not just quantity), first call GET /api/workers/me/products/{ProductCode}/packages to find a valid new PackageCode, then send that item with PackageCode set to the new value and OriginalPackageCode set to the PackageCode Gate originally declared for that product line. Backend re-derives the rate snapshot (weight/rate can differ by package) before accepting — an invalid/inactive PackageCode is rejected with 409 PRODUCT_PACKAGE_NOT_FOUND. Items not switching a package only need PackageCode as before.
Financial boundary: This request only records confirmed actual quantities and starts vendor confirmation. It must not create final financial records before vendor confirm or timeout auto-confirm.
Notes: {{ticketNumber}} is the vehicle-level TicketNumber of the worker's current assignment. TicketNo and BoothCode come from the accepted/check-in job payload (Markets[].TicketNo / Markets[].Stalls[].BoothCode). Backend resolves each product by ProductCode + PackageCode. The LINE message to the vendor shows both the originally declared package and the new one when a product's package was switched. The response does not expose LINE postback tokens. Vendor confirm completes financialization; vendor reject returns the ticket to REJECT for resubmission.

Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/line/webhook
Auth: No auth. LINE signature is required only when LINE_CHANNEL_SECRET is configured.
Body: Manual mock LINE postback using the same token-only format as the real LINE Flex buttons. source.userId should use {{lineUserId}} from the seed mapping. In normal use, vendor taps Confirm in LINE OA and this request is sent by LINE, not Postman. Confirms the waiting ticket completion, notifies worker/admin, and sends a 1-5 optional rating Flex prompt to the confirming LINE user. If this confirmation makes every ticket in the vehicle job terminal, backend closes the market/vehicle job and sets AssignmentStatus to COMPLETED so workers can go online for the next job. If there is another stall job, AssignmentStatus returns to WORKING. If vendor taps a rating score, backend replies with a thank-you Flex card and a temporary 0.00 baht service-charge summary card.

Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/line/webhook
Auth: No auth. LINE signature is required only when LINE_CHANNEL_SECRET is configured.
Body: Manual mock LINE postback using the same token-only format as the real LINE Flex buttons. source.userId should use {{lineUserId}} from the seed mapping. In normal use, vendor taps Reject in LINE OA and this request is sent by LINE, not Postman. Optional RejectReason is saved to the stall job and returned by Admin operations/history until the worker resubmits. Rejects the waiting ticket completion, sends a reject result Flex card to vendor, sets AssignmentStatus to REJECT, then the worker can submit the ticket completion again.

Method: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/line/webhook
Auth: No auth. LINE signature is required only when LINE_CHANNEL_SECRET is configured.
Body: Manual mock LINE rating postback. source.userId should use {{lineUserId}} from the seed mapping. Score must be 1-5. In normal use, vendor taps one of the optional rating buttons after confirming completion. Backend stores one rating per Ticket and LINE user; if the same LINE user taps again, the latest score replaces the old one. After a valid rating, backend sends a thank-you Flex card and a temporary 0.00 baht service-charge summary card.
